title: Quillwork shared definitions
description: Identifier grammars shared by every other schema. The patterns are the normative form of spec/anchors.md.

SpecVersion.description: SemVer of the spec this payload conforms to, including optional prerelease/build identifiers.

Version.description: Document version. A fresh Rust engine starts at 0; Python and service uploads start at 1. Every committed transaction adds one. Persisted counters retain their identity.

StoryId.description: b = main body; h<n> header, f<n> footer, fn<n> footnote, en<n> endnote, c<n> comment, tb<n> text box.

BlockAnchor.description: A paragraph handle: story + Crockford base32 serial (b1dk, h1-02, fn3-1).

Anchor.description: Any addressable thing: block, table, row, cell, image or comment.

AnchorOrRange.description: One anchor, or an inclusive range a..b of top-level blocks in one story.

Selection.description: What read_document's range accepts: comma-separated anchors, closed ranges a..b and open ranges a.. (one window from a).

RevisionId.description: The w:id of a w:ins/w:del/w:*Change element.

AssetId.description: a_ + the first 16 hex digits of sha256(bytes).

Expect.description: Guard on the target block's current accepted-mode text (NFC). text = the whole text; hash = sha256: + at least 12 lowercase hex digits of sha256(UTF-8 text).

ProjectionLine.description: One line of the LLM projection (spec/projection.md), without the trailing newline.

HalfPoints.description: Font size in half points (22 = 11 pt).

StoryKeyId.description: A story that lives in the view model's stories map: every story but the body (b) and comments (c<n>, which live in comments[]).

TextSelection.description: A text range as the viewer reports it. Offsets count UTF-16 code units in the text model (spec/projection.md §10): accepted text, \t per tab, \n per line break, a field's result, nothing for deletions, list labels, note marks or images.

anchor.description: The block, or the range of blocks, the selection spans.

start.description: Offset into the first paragraph's text.

end.description: Offset into the last paragraph's text (exclusive).

text.description: The selected text in the text model; paragraphs joined with \n.

startBlock.description: The paragraph start indexes, when anchor is a range, table or row.

endBlock.description: The paragraph end indexes, when anchor is a range, table or row.
